The New 2027 Thor Aria Diesel Pusher Model 4000 Optional Features 400 Watt Additional Solar Charging System  This RV is approximately 41 feet 1 inches in length and features (3) slide-out rooms, drop down overhead loft, king size Tilt-A-View inclining bed, residential refrigerator, solid surface counter tops, stack washer/dryer and rear master bath w/ dual sinks.
